Accenture Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year Fiscal 2026 Results

NEW YORK; Oct. 1, 2026 -- Accenture (NYSE: ACN) reported financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, ended Aug. 31, 2026, with revenues of $17.6 billion for the fourth quarter.

New bookings for the quarter were $20.1 billion, an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars.
